made_for: issue 1877 (Ryan, Nov 24 2026 12:34 UTC: "Yes bone bolts ... ensure we have new sound for it"; name Acid Thorns, 12:55 UTC). The Chorus close-in weapon is a built bone thorn: the gland snaps it out, it bites into the plating and sticks, acid sheets down, then it crumbles.
note: Three new cues, four takes each (RULEBOOK 8.4: four takes is the starting count), written the Gate 3 way (contrib/opus/plans/cohesive_audio_v2.md sections 2 to 8: identity first, one size word, no banned words, dry weapons). Today the thorn plays gun_shell (the tendril look is not in battle.gd's style list), a metal gun sound: the wiring after Ryan's pick adds tendril to the spine style with a chorus.tendril variant on gun_spine, a chorus.tendril hit variant, and the crumble on the thorn's own crumble time.

items.cue: gun_spine variant chorus.tendril (Acid Thorns: one thorn leaving the gland)
items.prompt: Living bone starship snapping one heavy bone thorn out of a fleshy gland: a deep wet muscular thunk, a hard tendon snap, and a short dense push of air as the thorn leaves. Organic and heavy, close and dry, one point source, firm clean attack, no reverb.

items.cue: hit variant chorus.tendril (Acid Thorns: the thorn bites into armour plate)
items.prompt: A thick bone thorn driving into armored starship plating: a hard bone crack and a heavy dull punch into steel, then a short wet splash and a sharp acid hiss as it starts to eat the metal. Heavy, close and dry, one point source, firm clean attack, no reverb.

items.cue: new moment: the stuck thorn crumbles (fx_acid_thorn.gd, 1.15 s after the hit)
items.prompt: A large dried bone thorn stuck in metal crumbling apart: brittle dry bone cracking into chips and grit that patter softly on a steel plate, with a faint acid fizz under it. Medium size, close and dry, one point source, soft clean attack, no reverb.
